items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The delivery envelope (Zustellungsurkunde, copied on page 2) shows formal service ('zugest. am') on Monday 23.11.2026; for formally served authority mail the printed/handwritten service date is used directly as the day of delivery, not the deemed-delivery fiction for ordinary post. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB the day of delivery (23.11.2026) is not counted; the two-week period (§ 67 Abs. 1 OWiG, counted per § 43 StPO with § 46 Abs. 1 OWiG) runs from 24.11.2026 and ends two weeks later on Monday 07.12.2026, which is a normal working day in Niedersachsen, so no shift is needed. The Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by that date.

items.title: Pay the total fine amount once the decision is final
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes 'rechtskräftig' only if no Einspruch is filed by the deadline above (07.12.2026); it becomes final the next day, 08.12.2026. Under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB that day of the triggering event is not counted, so the two-week payment period runs from 09.12.2026 and ends two weeks later on Tuesday 22.12.2026, a normal working day, so no weekend/holiday shift applies. This date is only valid if no Einspruch is lodged; filing an Einspruch would stop this payment deadline entirely.

warnings: The payment due date (22.12.2026) is calculated assuming no Einspruch is filed and the decision becomes final on 08.12.2026 (the day after the 07.12.2026 objection deadline); filing an Einspruch removes this payment deadline until the matter is resolved.

Before paying, verify the IBAN DE68 2825 0110 0002 6382 00 against a trusted, independently obtained contact for the Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven Bußgeldstelle (e.g. by phone using a number you look up yourself), since the letter's own printed contact details cannot by themselves confirm who controls that account.

Page 2 is a scan/copy of the delivery envelope rather than an original; the handwritten service date '23.11.2026' was used as the delivery date for this calculation — double-check it against the envelope you actually received.
